Headquarters: Remote - India

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
Location Note

We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India.

The Opportunity

Oportun is seeking a talented, customer-focused, and analytical Senior Product Manager to join the Servicing & Payments team. You will help create a trusted post-disbursement experience that strengthens members' confidence in Oportun, supports their financial health, and encourages continued engagement and repeat member behavior.

You will define product strategy, set measurable objectives and key results, create outcome-oriented roadmaps, and partner with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, and other teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. You will help make repayment easy, intelligent, successful, and accurately reflected for lending members.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You'll define and execute product strategy and roadmaps that improve repayment outcomes, member trust, and repeat engagement.

• You'll own initiatives end to end - from discovery and requirements through delivery, measurement, and iteration.

• You'll create simple, transparent, and reliable servicing and payment experiences across self-service and assisted channels.

• You'll use member insights, data, and experimentation to improve payer rate, payment success, DQ prevention, and lending-member NPS.

• You'll lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, legal, and finance.

• You'll communicate product strategy, trade-offs, progress, and measurable business impact to senior stakeholders.

• You'll bring ideas for how we can do things better - proactively, not just when asked.

• You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully - to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You're customer-focused and analytical, with a track record of navigating complex problems and turning member needs and data into practical product decisions. You're collaborative, communicate clearly, and build consensus across a wide range of cross-functional partners.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

• You'll have 5+ years of product management experience in high-growth environments.

• You've demonstrated experience partnering with business executives and cross-functional teams across compliance, risk, operations, fraud, technology, business intelligence, finance, training, legal, and cybersecurity.

• You bring strong analytical problem-solving skills, including experience with data-informed decision making, testing and experimentation, metric definition, and data analysis.

• You've demonstrated a track record of shipping and iterating on impactful products while building consensus across a broad group of cross-functional partners.

• You bring strong product execution skills and the ability to help teams push through obstacles and blockers to deliver value for members.

• You communicate clearly and concisely and have strong documentation skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience launching products within complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including financial services.

• Experience with SQL.

• Experience working with a multinational workforce.

• You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

WORKING AT OPORTUN

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

India Benefits: 

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance; 

• Provident Fund; Life & Accident Insurance; 

• Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances.

This is a summary of select benefits and does not represent the full benefits package. Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.
About The Role

Galileo is looking for culturally sensitive clinicians to join our digital-first, primary care medical group. In this role, you will use asynchronous text-based chat and synchronous video to provide high-quality, comprehensive and evidence-based primary care. As a part of our collaborative clinical care team, you will leverage data, technology, and operational rigor to optimize great patient outcomes while offering highly personalized care and shared decision making with patients. 

Here’s What You’ll Do:

• Provide best-in-class care for Galileo patients managing complex and chronic illnesses through our innovative, proprietary app and technology and your excellent clinical judgment.

• Provide compassionate and empathetic care to patients from age 0-100 across all needs, including complex, chronic medical conditions such as: diabetes, hypertension, obesity and mental health.

• Work with a diverse patient population. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture that is inclusive of all backgrounds.

• Solve patient problems in an efficient, nimble manner by drawing on resourcefulness, collaborating with team members to leverage their expertise, and a “can-do” approach.

How We Work

Galileo is a 24/7 medical group utilizing asynchronous text-based chat and synchronous video to provide high-quality, comprehensive primary care. We work in 4-hour shifts (mornings, afternoons, evenings, overnight on weekdays and weekends). At 24+ hours you will be considered full-time and benefits eligible. Providers are required to work at least two 4 hour shifts each weekend, in addition to their weekday hours.

We are currently looking for a Nurse Practitioner who can work a minimum of 24 hours/week.

Compensation

$80/hour (regular rate) and $90/hour (premium rate)

About You

We look for passionate clinicians who are invested in solving complex problems that impact millions of lives and are excited about fixing what’s broken to improve care quality and health outcomes for everyone. We believe in a culture that fosters teamwork, excellence, and sound decision-making—one that is based on mutual respect and trust. We appreciate individuals who are open and honest about what they’re looking for so we can ensure it’s a fit on both sides.

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

• Have 5+ years of advanced clinical experience in complex care, chronic care management, or primary care.

• Are experienced in or have an appetite for learning digital-first healthcare (e.g. virtual medicine).

• Are interested in new, innovative models of care that balance evidence-based approaches with creative ideas.

• Are highly comfortable with using technology and various applications to deliver care to patients virtually. Our current tech stack is:

• Proprietary built clinician-patient platform 

• Google Suite (gmail, sheets, docs, etc) 

• Slack

• Board certified as a Nurse Practitioner

• Have an active NP license in NY. Multi-licensed in other states preferred.

• Proficiency with written and spoken medical Spanish is a nice to have

How We Care for You:

• Flexible scheduling - design the schedule that works best for YOU

• Competitive health, vision and dental plans

• Company paid short and long term disability

• 12 weeks paid parental leave 

• Malpractice insurance provided, including tail coverage 

• 401(k) with company match

How We Hire

Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/galileo-digital-nurse-practitioner-remote-ny-license

WHO YOU ARE • Distributed Systems Expert: Master's in Computer Science or Data Engineering with 5+ years of hands-on experience in distributed computing, large-scale Apache Spark workloads, and Kubernetes container orchestration. • Cloud-Native & IaC Fluent: Highly proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm) and cloud-native microservices architecture. • DataOps & MLOps Practitioner: Proven track record in streamlining CI/CD for big data pipelines, deploying ML models, and working with modern Lakehouse technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and search engines (Elasticsearch). • A Systems Builder & Owner: You thrive in high-stakes, fast-paced environments. The role will be responsible for ensuring optimum utilization of funds, managing banking and credit facilities, developing financial models, preparing CMA data and supporting the organization's overall funding and liquidity requirements.

• Analyze the company's financial position and identify funding requirements.

• Support management in financial decision-making through detailed financial analysis.

• Prepare and monitor budgets, cash-flow projections and financial forecasts.

• Evaluate various debt and financing options based on business requirements.

• Manage existing and proposed debt facilities, including working capital and term loans.

5. Treasury Management

• Ensure optimum utilization of available funds.

• Monitor bank balances, fund movements, interest costs and short-term funding requirements.

• Good understanding of financial statements, cash flows and financial ratios.

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

14d5bf580e9d4568.description:
Arrangr | Growth Lead, Expansion & Lifecycle | REMOTE | Fixed-fee project ($12K, milestone-based) + equity tied to ARR results → founding role | https://arrangr.com
Arrangr is a scheduling platform with tens of thousands of registered users and hundreds of thousands of people reached through scheduling invitations. Calendly is the incumbent, and it's good. Our thesis: booking links make it efficient to fill your calendar, not productive. Every open slot looks identical, so your best hours go to whoever clicks first. Arrangr schedules by importance.
The opportunity: we can see which companies already have several people using Arrangr individually. Each of those is an unmonetized team. You'd build the motion that converts them (in-product surface, sequences, landing page, pilot) and handle the replies it generates: seats, admin rights, security questions. Then reactivate a large dormant base and fix acquisition.
The engagement: five milestones over roughly three months, $12K paid on milestone completion, milestones 1 and 2 contracted first. "Done" means shipped, instrumented and measured against a baseline. Equity is a defined grant tied to new ARR booked; hitting the middle tier triggers a founding title. Engineering time is limited, so you ship within existing product surfaces.
Right for you if you've run PQL-to-team expansion and reactivation against a base in the tens of thousands. Not for CRO specialists (our volume won't support the testing), paid media buyers, or anyone who wants to manage a team. There is no team. You're it.
To apply: no cover letter. Email adams@arrangr.com with three links to things you personally built, one line each on what the numbers did. Plus one answer: we can see which companies have several individual users. How would you turn that into team conversions, and have you run that motion before?
I read and reply to every one. – Adam, co-founder/CEO

14e05059f3859f81.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a hardcore Senior QA Automation Engineer to drive quality and reliability across our entire technology stack. Your primary mission is to build, scale, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for our consumer web storefronts, mobile applications, and backend systems. While your foundation must be rooted in traditional, high-rigor automation, you must also be a forward-thinking engineer. As we increasingly integrate AI into our products and workflows, you will be expected to learn, adopt, and eventually champion Agentic AI tools, both to accelerate your own QA processes and to validate our upcoming GenAI features. **What You Will Do** **Core Test Automation (The Primary Focus):** * Framework Architecture: Build and scale highly maintainable automated testing frameworks from scratch for Web and Mobile (including Flutter or native apps) using modern tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Appium. * API & Backend Validation: Conduct rigorous backend testing for high-throughput REST/GraphQL APIs. Ensure data integrity across distributed systems, payment gateways, and backend operational platforms (such as ERPs). * Omnichannel E2E Testing: Design comprehensive test suites that validate complex user journeys from the frontend consumer touchpoint all the way through to backend order fulfillment and inventory systems. * CI/CD Integration: Embed automated test suites into cloud deployment pipelines (e.g., AWS, GitHub Actions) to act as reliable gatekeepers for zero-downtime releases. **AI Integration & Future Readiness:** * AI-Assisted QA: Actively explore and integrate AI coding agents (like Cursor or Copilot) to accelerate test script generation, automate edge-case discovery, and build self-healing tests. * GenAI Feature Testing: Partner with the engineering team to design testing strategies for upcoming AI-driven features (such as automated customer support chatbots or internal AI assistants), moving beyond strict binary assertions to evaluate probabilistic outcomes. **What We Are Looking For (Must-Haves)** * Experience: 4-5 years of proven, hands-on experience as an SDET or Automation QA Engineer in a fast-paced environment. * Programming Proficiency: Strong coding fundamentals in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java. * Tooling Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of UI automation (Playwright/Cypress) and Mobile automation (Appium). * API Testing: Extensive experience using Postman, RestAssured, or custom scripts to validate complex API architectures and database state changes. * Adaptability: A strong willingness and readiness to learn GenAI concepts, LLM architectures, and how to test non-deterministic AI systems. **Nice to Have** * Prior exposure to GenAI or Agentic AI testing (e.g., prompt validation, evaluating RAG pipelines, or testing AI tool-calling). * Domain experience in E-commerce, Retail Tech, or omnichannel supply chain systems. * Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and containerization (AWS, Docker).

144521e714d7471d.description: We are seeking an experienced ITSM Business Analyst to join our team in Andhra Pradesh or Telangana. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in IT Service Management (ITSM) and a proven track record in business analysis, particularly in the area of asset management. This role is critical in ensuring that our IT services align with the business needs and that we effectively manage our IT assets throughout their lifecycle. Key Responsibilities: - Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements related to ITSM and asset management. - Develop and document functional specifications and use cases to support ITSM initiatives. - Work closely with IT teams to ensure that IT services are delivered effectively and meet business expectations. - Conduct regular reviews of IT asset management processes and recommend improvements. - Facilitate training sessions and workshops to educate staff on ITSM best practices and asset management processes. - Monitor and report on the performance of IT services and asset management initiatives, providing insights for continuous improvement. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks and methodologies. - Proven experience as a Business Analyst, with a focus on asset management. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams. - Familiarity with IT asset management tools and software. If you are a proactive and detail-oriented professional with a passion for ITSM and asset management, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in driving efficiency and effectiveness in our IT services.
